meta.title: Arabic Presentations with True RTL Support | taqreer.ai
meta.description: Create Arabic presentations that export to PowerPoint with correct right-to-left direction, proper alignment, numbers and English terms in the right place, and authentic Arabic fonts. taqreer.ai handles bidirectional text end to end.

hero.title: Arabic presentations, formatted right
hero.subtitle: Arabic is more than a translation. taqreer.ai designs and exports your decks with correct right-to-left direction, alignment, numbers, and Arabic fonts that stay intact, even inside PowerPoint.

compare.title: Arabic, the way it should look
compare.subtitle: Many tools break Arabic text direction when exporting to PowerPoint. These are real examples of what goes wrong, and how taqreer.ai fixes it.

modes.name: Direction and alignment
modes.desc: Arabic reads from the right. A naive export anchors it to the left and reverses the reading order. taqreer.ai keeps the correct direction and alignment.

modes.name: Numbers and percentages
modes.desc: Percentages and dates jump to the wrong side or detach from the sentence. taqreer.ai keeps them in place within the Arabic text.

modes.name: Arabic with Latin
modes.desc: Brand names and English terms scatter inside the Arabic sentence. taqreer.ai keeps them as a Latin island in the right spot.

modes.name: Punctuation
modes.desc: Commas and question marks land on the wrong side. taqreer.ai places them where they belong in right-to-left text.

how.title: How Arabic export works
how.subtitle: After designing each slide, taqreer.ai post-processes the PowerPoint file itself so Arabic renders correctly.

steps.title: Designed in the browser
steps.body: The AI designs each slide as a web page, so the browser handles bidirectional text ordering precisely.

steps.title: High-fidelity export
steps.body: taqreer.ai converts the slide to PowerPoint while preserving the layout and fonts instead of rebuilding them.

steps.title: Direction post-processing
steps.body: A final pass sets each paragraph's direction, alignment, and text language inside the file, so Arabic shows correctly in PowerPoint.

why.title: Why taqreer.ai for Arabic
why.subtitle: Bidirectional text is the core of the product, not an afterthought.

points.title: Always correct direction
points.body: Every slide exports right-to-left with proper alignment, in the browser and in PowerPoint.

points.title: Numbers in place
points.body: Percentages, dates, and English terms stay in the right spot inside Arabic text.

points.title: Authentic Arabic fonts
points.body: Arabic fonts are embedded in the file and their letters stay connected as designed.

points.title: Clean export
points.body: The deck opens in PowerPoint with its full Arabic layout intact and editable.

faq.q: Does taqreer.ai fully support Arabic?
faq.a: Yes. taqreer.ai is Arabic-first. Every slide is designed and exported with correct right-to-left direction and full support for bidirectional text and Arabic fonts.

faq.q: What happens to Arabic when exporting to PowerPoint?
faq.a: Many tools break Arabic direction on export. taqreer.ai post-processes the PowerPoint file to guarantee correct direction, alignment, and the placement of numbers and punctuation inside Arabic text.

faq.q: Do numbers and English words show correctly inside Arabic text?
faq.a: Yes. Percentages, dates, and English brand names stay in the correct place inside the Arabic sentence instead of jumping to the wrong side.

faq.q: Do Arabic fonts stay intact after export?
faq.a: Yes. Arabic fonts are embedded in the PowerPoint file and their letters stay connected in the correct shape, without falling back to a substitute font.

faq.q: What is taqreer.ai?
faq.a: taqreer.ai is an AI platform that turns your content, text, a file, or an idea, into a fully designed professional presentation in Arabic and English within minutes.

faq.q: How do I design a presentation with AI?
faq.a: Write your topic or upload a file in taqreer.ai, choose your brand, and the AI designs a complete presentation in minutes that you can edit and export to PowerPoint.

faq.q: Does taqreer.ai design presentations and reports in Arabic?
faq.a: Yes. taqreer.ai is Arabic-first with full right-to-left support and Arabic fonts, and it turns your ideas and data into designed presentations and reports in Arabic and English.

faq.q: Does it fully support Arabic?
faq.a: Yes. taqreer.ai is Arabic-first: correct RTL direction, elegant Arabic fonts, and bidirectional formatting that handles English words and numbers inside Arabic text accurately.

faq.q: How does the credit system work?
faq.a: Each deck uses credits based on its slide count and the model used. You get monthly credits with your plan, plus {credits} free credits at signup to try the platform.

faq.q: Can I edit the deck after creating it?
faq.a: Absolutely. The editor lets you edit text, colors, and slides and reorder them, with autosave and checkpoints you can revert to anytime.

faq.q: Can I export the deck to PowerPoint?
faq.a: Yes. You can export your decks as editable PPTX for PowerPoint while preserving the Arabic formatting and text direction.

faq.q: Can I apply my own brand identity?
faq.a: Yes. Upload your logo, colors, and fonts in the brand identity section, and taqreer.ai applies them automatically so your decks stay on-brand.

faq.q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.a: Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime from your account settings, with no long-term commitment.
